tokens.{heading_2}: Changing the world one micron at a time
tokens.{body_1}: Our customers span many industries: medical device, biotech, semiconductor, automotive, aerospace and more.
tokens.{body_2}: Micro-drilling for microfluidic devices, precise vias, channels and ports in glass, polymers and foils, from rapid prototyping to scalable production.
tokens.{body_3}: Laser-drilled micro-holes in glass and polymer vials and ampoules for container closure integrity and leak-test system validation.
tokens.{body_4}: High-resolution micro-hole drilling for concealed displays, precise, uniform holes for invisible backlit indicators and controls.
tokens.{body_5}: Quick, cost-effective small-hole drilling in most materials, microholes as small as 1 micron in almost any substrate.
tokens.{body_6}: Micro-hole drilling for probe cards in silicon nitride, polyimide, Ultem and other engineered substrates.
tokens.{body_7}: Precision laser micro-hole drilling for medical catheters, hole sizes down to microns, biocompatible materials, ISO 13485 and fast turnaround.
